name: The JEE Main 2027 Starter Handbook — Digital Edition
tagline: The complete 34-page starter kit for JEE Main 2027 Session 1 on 22-30 January 2027 — NTA's 16 September calendar decoded, the October registration walkthrough with fees and documents, percentile and normalisation explained with 2026 data, all 53 official syllabus units mapped, PCM playbooks, the 16-week sprint plan, and the JoSAA-CSAB counselling roadmap.
